items.summary:
Fake Virus Popup Scam

You're browsing the web and suddenly a loud siren blares from your speakers. A giant red popup fills the screen: "WARNING: 47 VIRUS DETECTED. Your files are being stolen. Call Microsoft Support NOW: 1-888-XXX-XXXX."

items.title: Firefox 157.0.1 Warns When Malware Reads Your Encrypted Traffic — Free at firefox.com
items.summary: Firefox 157.0.1 adds a new shield icon warning when software on your PC (like corporate monitoring tools or malware) intercepts your encrypted traffic. Click the shield to see which software is doing it, then decide whether to allow it or remove it. Most people have no idea their "secure" banking session can be read by something else on their computer. Get the update free at firefox.com

items.title: Windows 10 Support Ends October 14, 2026 — Free Upgrade to Windows 11 at Settings > Update
items.summary: After October 14, 2026, Windows 10 stops receiving security updates. Your computer will keep working, but it won't be safe to use online. Upgrade to Windows 11 for free at Settings > Windows Update > Check for Updates. Most PCs from 2018 or newer are eligible. Get the free upgrade at Settings > Windows Update

items.title: That CAPTCHA Asking You to Press Windows+R Is a Scam
items.summary: A fake CAPTCHA pops up and tells you to press the Windows key + R, paste something, and hit Enter. **Don't do it.** That "verification" is a trap — it pastes malicious code into Windows Run and executes it. Real CAPTCHAs never ask for keyboard commands. Ever.

items.title: CISA warns: These vulnerabilities are being exploited right now — patch your software
items.summary: CISA added Microsoft SharePoint CVE-2026-65660 and Windows Shell CVE-2026-96951 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog this week. Update Windows at Settings > Windows Update. If you run on-premises SharePoint Server 2016, 2019, or Subscription Edition, install the August 2026 security update from the Microsoft Update Catalog.

items.title: Firefox 157 brings a fresh look and Compact Mode — free update at firefox.com
items.summary: Firefox 157 adds a modern visual redesign called Nova and a Compact Mode that reduces toolbar and tab spacing to leave more room for web content. Update free at firefox.com or click the menu button (three lines) > Help > About Firefox to install automatically.

items.title: Clearwave Fiber expands in Lake City — check if your address qualifies at clearwavefiber.com
items.summary: Clearwave Fiber is bringing high-speed fiber internet to more Lake City neighborhoods. Check availability for your address free at clearwavefiber.com. Fiber gives you symmetrical upload and download speeds — great for video calls, backups, and working from home.

items.title: Stop paying for WinZip — 7-Zip 26.04 is the free file compressor that handles every format at 7-zip.org
items.summary: 7-Zip 26.04 (released October 5, 2026) is free, open-source, and opens every archive format including ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, GZIP, and more. It compresses better than WinZip and has no ads, no trial nags, no subscriptions. Download the 64-bit Windows installer free at 7-zip.org.
